title: Last Respects (move)
text:
Last Respects (Japanese: おはかまいり Visit to the Grave) is a damage-dealing Ghost-type move introduced in Generation IX.

== Effect ==
Last Respects inflicts damage. Its base power, which starts at 50, is increased by an additional 50 each time a Pokémon in the user's party faints during a battle. Revived Pokémon who then faint again also count, with the base power capping at 5,050 after Pokémon faint 100 times in the same battle.
